{{Quote|Now we vanquish ''any'' who still hold to his ways... who will not serve the ''Imperial'' cause! As the ''Empire'' rules the galaxy&mdash;Droid World is ours to command!|Z-X3, after seemingly killing Kligson|<ref name="SW47" />}}
'''Z-X3''', also known as '''Zee-Exthree''', was a [[Z-X3 experimental droid trooper]] created by [[Tagge Company/Legends|Tagge Industries]] during the era of the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]]. An experimental model rejected for service in the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] military, Z-X3 instead found a home on [[Kligson's Moon/Legends|Kligson's Moon]], an all-[[Droid/Legends|droid]] society led by a [[Cyborg/Legends|cyborg]] named [[Kligson/Legends|Kligson]]. However, Z-X3 secretly harbored Imperial loyalty, and plotted to overthrow Kligson and seize "Droid World" in the Empire's name. Z-X3 finally made his move in [[3 ABY/Legends|3 ABY]], only to be outsmarted and defeated in the ensuing [[Kligson's Moon civil war|civil war]].

==Biography==
{{Quote|I am an ''experimental model'', designed by Taage Industries to work under extreme planetary conditions even ''stormtroopers'' couldn't survive. The Imperials were not ''satisfied''&hellip; I was ''rejected''. Fortunately&mdash;Kligson ''reclaimed'' me, and has now given me many ''new'' opportunities.|Z-X3, to [[C-3PO/Legends|C-3PO]]|<ref name="SW47" />}}
One of less than a hundred [[Z-X3 experimental droid trooper]]s ever produced,<ref name="TNEGtD" /> the [[Droid/Legends|droid]] later simply known as Z-X3 was produced by the [[Tagge Company/Legends|Tagge Company]]<ref name="SW47" /> at the behest of [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] [[Officer/Legends|officer]] [[Rom Mohc]], who had faced deadly [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Separatist]] [[Battle droid/Legends|battle droids]] during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]] and had become intrigued by the idea of [[Droid/Legends|droid]] troops backing up the Empire's [[Stormtrooper/Legends|stormtroopers]]. However, the concept of droid soldiers had fallen out of favor among Imperial decision-makers due to the Separatists' defeat in the Clone Wars, and the program was scrapped. Most of the surviving Z-X3 droids found their way into private ownership<ref name="TNEGtD" /> Z-X3 instead found his way to [[Kligson's Moon/Legends|Kligson's Moon]], the "Droid World" of [[Spacer/Legends|spacer]] legend, a [[Space station/Legends|space station]] that had been transformed into a wholly mechanical society.<ref name="SW47" />

[[File:ZeeExThree.jpg|thumb|left|250px|Z-X3 in 3 ABY.]]
Z-X3 was taken in by [[Kligson/Legends|Kligson]],<ref name="SW47" /> a veteran of the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]] who had suffered severe wounds while serving in the [[Imperial Army/Legends|Imperial Army]], and had retreated from organic contact after being turned into a [[Cyborg/Legends|cyborg]].<ref name="EGWAC8">{{SW|url=news/star-wars-the-essential-guide-to-warfare-authors-cut|series=Star Wars: The Essential Guide to Warfare Author's Cut|text=Part 8: Tales of the Clone Wars}}</ref> Kligson ran his "Droid World," and made Z-X3 a critical part of his operation&mdash;by [[3 ABY/Legends|3 ABY]], Z-X3 had become his right-hand droid. But while Kligson, who had committed to an anti-war philosophy after his maiming and rebuilding, had wanted to keep his station out of the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]], Z-X3 still maintained a secret allegiance to the Empire. Over time, Z-X3 built a clandestine [[Z-X3's faction|faction]] of like-minded droids that aimed to overthrow Kligson and claim the Droid World for the Empire. In [[3 ABY/Legends|3 ABY]], Z-X3 seemingly got the opportunity he wanted, when [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel]] [[Commander/Legends|Commander]] [[Luke Skywalker/Legends|Luke Skywalker]] arrived at Kligson's Moon, hoping that the talented [[Technician/Legends|technician]] could give him a full schematic of a captured [[Imperial warbot]].<ref name="SW47" />

Z-X3 wanted to use the head of Skywalker's warbot to repair a similar, derelict model his faction held, but when Z-X3 noticed Skywalker's droid [[R2-D2/Legends|R2-D2]] spying on them, he drastically moved up his timetable for rebellion. Z-X3 stormed the station's [[Bridge (starship)/Legends|bridge]] and seemingly [[Death/Legends|killed]] Kligson, believing that he had delivered the Droid World to the Empire. However, Kligson had outsmarted them, having suspected Z-X3's treachery for some time. Kligson had secretly hidden behind an [[Kligson's android duplicate|android duplicate]] in an attempt to draw Z-X3 out, and reappeared to completely [[Kligson's Moon civil war|destroy]] Z-X3 and his faction with his now-functioning Imperial warbot.<ref name="SW47" />

==Characteristics==
{{Quote|This kind of product isn't ''worth'' the effort. Most Imperial handiwork ''isn't''&mdash;''Zee-Exthree'' here is one of the exceptions.|Kligson|<ref name="SW47" />}}
Although outwardly loyal to Kligson and grateful for the opportunities the cyborg afforded the rejected Imperial war droid, Z-X3 still maintained a secret loyalty to the Empire that persisted long after the Imperials abandoned him. In fact, Z-X3 scorned Kligson and plotted against him behind his back, hating the cyborg body that he believed mocked that of a true droid's.<ref name="SW47" /> Specifically created to thrive in environments difficult for organic soldiers, Zee-Exthree had plating inspired by Imperial stormtroopers but [[Color/Legends|colored]] a distinct shade of crimson. 1.9 [[Meter/Legends|meters]] tall, it fought with an [[AAP-II blaster box]] in its chest, while boasting enhanced strength and intelligence that wasn't dependent on a central [[Computer/Legends|computer]].<ref name="TNEGtD" />

==Behind the scenes==
[[File:Zx3.jpg|thumb|Z-X3, as he appears in The Further Adventures: Droid World]]
Z-X3 first appeared in [[Star Wars (1977) 47|''Star Wars'' (1977) 47]], written by [[Archie Goodwin]] and released in [[1981]]. In the comic, the droid was illustrated by [[Carmine Infantino]],<ref name="SW47" /> and he was additionally drawn by [[Dick Foes]] in the book-and-record ''[[The Further Adventures: Droid World]]''.<ref name="further">''[[The Further Adventures: Droid World]]''</ref>
